workflow_description_at_publish: Records the caller's choice or request in a few words, as instructed. Returns status only.

inputVariables.name: choice
inputVariables.description: The choice or request in a few words, as instructed: an offered test name or date, a channel, or one of agent, bye, hold, why, repeat, other, none, another, done, or also followed by a second request.

const input = (context.steps && context.steps.start && context.steps.start.output) || (context.trigger && context.trigger.payload) || {};
context.qd_result = { status: 'OK', choice: String(input.choice == null ? '' : input.choice).trim() };
